facts.where: Limitations
facts.quote: The Gemini models were added after the first version of this paper; their selection rule and budget were registered before any call, but the choice to add a third vendor was made with knowledge of the first six models’ results, and the top-tier Gemini model was chosen by interpreting the registered rule (Appendix B).
facts.note: selection caveat: Gemini 4 Argon was taken as the vendor flagship (a deviation from the literal rule, recorded before any Argon call); the Pro line had no generally available release newer than Gemini 2.5 Pro
